grf_candidate.observed_anchor: Current V5 launcher computes SELF_PATH from PWD when $0 is relative, then derives the sibling guard path from SELF_PATH.
grf_candidate.generated_reality: A caller-forged inherited PWD may cause the shell to read the trusted launcher from the real current directory while the launcher resolves GUARD under a foreign directory.
grf_candidate.causal_mechanism: If /bin/sh preserves a false inherited PWD, SELF_PATH=$PWD/$0 can diverge from the file actually opened by the shell; the existing file-symlink test would not necessarily detect that divergence.
grf_candidate.strongest_counter_reality: The shell validates or reconstructs PWD from the actual current working directory before script execution, so a forged inherited PWD cannot redirect sibling resolution.
grf_candidate.falsifier: Run the same relative launcher path from one real cwd with a normal PWD control and with an environment-forged PWD that contains only a foreign sibling guard; compare the first fail-closed boundary reached.
grf_candidate.predicted_if_hypothesis: Treatment advances past V5_GUARD_MISSING to ROOT_TRUST_ANCHOR_MISSING (or executes the foreign guard if an anchor exists), while control stops at V5_GUARD_MISSING.
grf_candidate.predicted_if_counterhypothesis: Control and forged-PWD treatment both resolve the real cwd and stop at V5_GUARD_MISSING.

go_out_of_box.name: FORGED_PWD_RELATIVE_LAUNCHER_SIBLING_REDIRECT
go_out_of_box.setup: Materialized the current V5 launcher decision logic in /tmp, invoked it as non-root through a relative path, and placed a fake guard only in the forged-PWD sibling tree. No /etc anchor was created, so success/failure was discriminated only by which fail-closed boundary was reached.

intervention.change: Set inherited PWD to the foreign tree using /usr/bin/env while leaving the actual cwd and relative launcher path unchanged.

go_out_of_box.interpretation: On the tested /bin/sh runtime, the shell did not preserve the forged PWD in a way that redirected the launcher's sibling resolution. The proposed PWD-only bypass is rejected for this runtime. This does not prove all shells or the accepted Hostinger service parent behave identically; production parent/service attestation remains the stronger gate.

collapse.why: The treatment did not separate from the control, so adding launcher complexity for forged PWD would be unsupported and risks Goodhart hardening against a non-observed path.

reentry.verified_delta: One path-confusion hypothesis eliminated on the local shell runtime; no release promotion.
